name: Governed Data Engineering Lifecycle
principle: All data moves through governed lifecycle layers with quality, reconciliation, lineage, security, observability and cost controls.

name: Governed Analytics and Dashboard Lifecycle
gcp_services: Looker or approved BI serving layer
principle: Dashboards consume certified Gold data products and a governed semantic layer with controlled access rather than operational sources directly.

name: Governed Machine Learning Lifecycle
gcp_services: Cloud Run when API serving applies
principle: ML solutions inherit governed data layers and add versioned features, model registry, evaluation, secure serving and model monitoring.

name: Governed GenAI and RAG Lifecycle
gcp_services: Vertex AI Vector Search or approved vector layer
principle: GenAI solutions use traceable governed knowledge, controlled retrieval, source attribution, security, evaluation and observability.

name: Governed Agentic AI Lifecycle
gcp_services: Cloud Run or Vertex AI Agent Runtime
principle: Agents may reason and recommend, but actions, identities, tools, approvals, auditability, rollback and security remain explicitly governed.
